ActionIds: Extra action IDs, comma separated (Enter clears). Profile actions remain; Custom selects only your actions

ApplyNotice: This makes real changes. PREVIEW compatibility is not VM-tested. Package mappings are candidates: review exact packages and free disk space. No package manager bootstrap. Defender Remove is blocked. The script never initiates a reboot, but third-party installers may behave differently.

Agreements: Accept licenses for selected apps and sources? Type YES
DataLoss: Appx removal may delete app data; no automatic restore. Accept risk? Type YES
RestoreId: RunId from JSON filename, without extension (Enter goes back)
ConfirmRestore: Restore original registry values? Apps require manual recovery. Type RESTORE
